title: OpenAI Just Showed Us What Comes After the Harness. Here's The Layer Almost Everyone's Missing.
content: The video introduces 'Symphony', an open-source agent orchestrator from OpenAI that leverages issue trackers (e.g., Linear) to manage autonomous coding agents, addressing the human bottleneck in scaling agentic workflows. It then presents the 'Agent Harness' architectural pattern, distinguishing between the built-in capabilities of the agent ('inner harness') and the external control systems ('outer harness'). The outer harness employs 'guides' for feed-forward and 'sensors' for feedback to steer the agent, enabling more reliable automation.

visual_intelligence.reason: Illustrates Symphony's integration with issue trackers and the state machine aspect.
